t: What Concentrated Solar Thermal Towers Is
title: What Concentrated Solar Thermal Towers Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Solar thermal towers surround a central tower with thousands of mirrors (heliostats) focusing sunlight to 1000 C+: the heat makes steam by day and stores in molten salt for power after sunset — solar with built-in storage. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Concentrated Solar Thermal Towers: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Concentrated Solar Thermal Towers in one line: Solar thermal towers surround a central tower with thousands of mirrors (heliostats) focusing sunlight to 1000 C+: the heat makes steam by day and stores in molten salt for power after sunset — solar with built-in storage.
Why it matters: Thermal storage is the cheapest grid storage; towers pair it with solar natively..
Where it is used: dispatchable solar power, industrial heat, desalination..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
